subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15, 2022. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK International Airport. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for check-in. If you have any special requirements or need assistance, please contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airline Team
